# 405 Rubber Mulch

> Wholesale truckload rubber mulch delivered by flatbed to Oklahoma, Kansas, Missouri and Arkansas. The wholesale arm of Jameson's Discount Home Improvement Warehouse, Oklahoma City metro (https://www.discountokc.com).

## Quick facts
- Product: chunk-nugget rubber mulch cut only from semi-truck tires. IPEMA-certified, tested to ASTM F1292, 99%+ metal-free. 12-year color-lock warranty on brown and red.
- Packaging: 2,000-lb supersacks. A full truck is 22 supersacks (44,000 lb).
- Color-locked brown or red adds $115 a sack at every quantity.
- Full-truck price, delivered: black $425 a sack ($9,350 a truck); brown or red $540 a sack ($11,880 a truck).
- Less than a full truck: $368 a sack plus $1,250 freight for the load (brown or red $483 a sack plus $1,250). Example: 7 black supersacks delivered = $3,826.
- More than 22 sacks: each full truck is $9,350 (black) and the remaining sacks are priced as a partial truck. Example: 33 black supersacks = $9,350 + (11 x $368 + $1,250 = $5,298) = $14,648 delivered.
- Delivered price examples (black): 5 sacks $3,090; 10 sacks $4,930; 15 sacks $6,770; 22 sacks $9,350.
- Coverage: one supersack covers about 150 sq ft at 6 inches (playgrounds) or 300 sq ft at 3 inches.
- Buyer unloads with forks rated for 2,000 lb. Schools and towns: purchase orders and bid paperwork welcome.
- Pickup: Jameson's, 7010 SE 15th St, Midwest City, OK and 8100 S. Santa Fe Ave, Oklahoma City, OK.
- Phone: (405) 206-8111
